note: Grade of each active street block, in percent, as [avg_grade, max_grade_100ft]: avg is the absolute elevation difference between the block's two end points over its centerline length; max is the steepest 100 ft stretch along the centerline. Elevation is the USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM (1 m lidar, CA_SanFrancisco_B23, 2023) resampled to 2 m and sampled every 2 m. Bridges, viaducts and tunnels take the ground's grade, not the deck's. Built by tools/school-trips/street-grades.py; source and check in sources/usgs-3dep-elevation.md.
